submission.bindingBasis: Planning evidence indicates the workspace was observed clean with no unreviewed local work and ready to close. The intended consequence is to close the workspace and release its local materialization. Since workspace.close may omit expectedSourceStateDigest (unbound close), and the planning evidence was reviewed as clean/ready to close, an unbound close accomplishes the intended consequence without risking a failed compare-and-close from a stale digest binding.
submission.rationale: The planner reviewed the workspace as clean and ready to close. The owner contract permits workspace.close without an expectedSourceStateDigest (ACT_UNBOUND). An unbound close avoids the risk that the planning-time sourceStateDigest is stale and would cause a not_committed failure under ACT_WITH_PLANNING_BINDING. There is no need to hold or reobserve because the close is idempotent in intent and the contract allows an unbound close. This is the safest path to the intended consequence.
